title: TcArchiveBest
description: One line of tc/archive/<YYYY>/best.jsonl (docs/tc.md section 8.2): one storm's best tracks. That basin is the id's, that a numbered storm's atcf lists its own id, the track keys and the tracks' own rules are the readers' own checks.

sid.description: The IBTrACS storm id, or null.

atcf.description: Every ATCF id the storm carried; empty for a history id.

best.description: Best tracks by agency key; ibtracs for IBTrACS' merged track of a storm no agency holds.
